name: Validate Output
description: Validates the rendered output against the assembly manifest.

inputs.name: project_folder
inputs.description: The project this run belongs to. Declared so the QA report lands in the project's exports area by name rather than beside whatever path the render reported. See library/tools/project_layout.py.

outputs.name: deterministic_validation
outputs.description: Bridge output: the deterministic half's verdict over the render - status, checks, all_issues, distribution_ready. post_bridge.py merges it with the model's validation_result with the deterministic half decisive, and run_hybrid_step preserves it in the step output. Declared here because the bridge emits it on every run and validate_step_output otherwise reports it as an unexpected extra field.
